```{r}
features <- c("age","educ","black","hisp","marr","nodegree","re74","re75")

Y_exp <- experimental_df$re78
A_exp <- experimental_df$treat

X_exp <- experimental_df[, features]

###
Y_obs <- observational_df$re78
A_obs <- observational_df$treat

X_obs <- observational_df[, features]

n_exp <- nrow(experimental_df)
n_obs <- nrow(observational_df)
K <- 5
```

```{r}
# k fold indicator
use_k_fold <- TRUE
```

```{r}
# propensity score
if (use_k_fold == FALSE){
  prop_model_exp <- glm(
    A ~ .,
    data = data.frame(A = A_exp, X_exp),
    family = binomial()
  )
  prop_model_obs <- glm(
    A ~ .,
    data = data.frame(A = A_obs, X_obs),
    family = binomial()
  )
  
  e_hat_exp <- predict(
    prop_model_exp,
    newdata = X,
    type = "response"
  )
  
  e_hat_obs <- predict(
    prop_model_obs,
    newdata = X,
    type = "response"
  )
}
```

```{r}
if (use_k_fold == TRUE){
  n_exp <- nrow(experimental_df)
  n_obs <- nrow(observational_df)
  K <- 5
  
  fold_id_exp <- sample(rep(1:K, length.out = n_exp))
  fold_id_obs <- sample(rep(1:K, length.out = n_obs))
  
  e_hat_exp <- rep(NA, n_exp)
  e_hat_obs <- rep(NA, n_obs)

  features <- c("age","educ","black","hisp","marr","nodegree","re74","re75")
  
  for (k in 1:K) {
  
    train_idx_exp <- which(fold_id_exp != k)
    test_idx_exp  <- which(fold_id_exp == k)
    
    train_idx_obs <- which(fold_id_obs != k)
    test_idx_obs  <- which(fold_id_obs == k)
  
    train_data_exp <- data.frame(A = A_exp[train_idx_exp], X_exp[train_idx_exp, ])
    test_data_exp  <- X_exp[test_idx_exp, ]
    
    train_data_obs <- data.frame(A = A_obs[train_idx_obs], X_obs[train_idx_obs, ])
    test_data_obs  <- X_obs[test_idx_obs, ]
  
    # fit model on training fold
    prop_model_k_exp <- glm(
      A ~ .,
      data = train_data_exp,
      family = binomial()
    )
    prop_model_k_obs <- glm(
      A ~ .,
      data = train_data_obs,
      family = binomial()
    )
  
    # predict on held-out fold
    e_hat_exp[test_idx_exp] <- predict(
      prop_model_k_exp,
      newdata = test_data_exp,
      type = "response"
    )
    e_hat_obs[test_idx_obs] <- predict(
      prop_model_k_obs,
      newdata = test_data_obs,
      type = "response"
    )
  }
}
```

```{r}
# outcome model
if (use_k_fold == FALSE) {
  mu_model_exp <- lm(re78 ~ ., data = data.frame(re78 = Y_exp, X_exp))
  mu_hat_exp <- predict(mu_model_exp, newdata = X_exp)
  
  mu_model_obs <- lm(re78 ~ ., data = data.frame(re78 = Y_obs, X_obs))
  mu_hat_obs <- predict(mu_model_obs, newdata = X_obs)
}
```

```{r}
if (use_k_fold == TRUE){
  n_exp <- nrow(experimental_df)
  n_obs <- nrow(observational_df)
  K <- 5
  
  mu_hat_exp <- rep(NA, n_exp)
  mu_hat_obs <- rep(NA, n_obs)
  
  # fold_id <- sample(rep(1:K, length.out = n))
  
  for (k in 1:K) {
  
    train_idx_exp <- which(fold_id_exp != k)
    test_idx_exp  <- which(fold_id_exp == k)
    
    train_idx_obs <- which(fold_id_obs != k)
    test_idx_obs  <- which(fold_id_obs == k)
  
    fit_exp <- lm(re78 ~ ., data = data.frame(re78 = Y_exp[train_idx_exp], 
                                              X_exp[train_idx_exp, ]))
    fit_obs <- lm(re78 ~ ., data = data.frame(re78 = Y_obs[train_idx_obs], 
                                              X_obs[train_idx_obs, ]))
  
    mu_hat_exp[test_idx_exp] <- predict(fit_exp, newdata = X_exp[test_idx_exp, ])
    mu_hat_obs[test_idx_obs] <- predict(fit_obs, newdata = X_obs[test_idx_obs, ])
  }
}
```

```{r}
# used Claude to help generate code
# r loss minimization
# residuals
Y_tilde_exp <- Y_exp - mu_hat_exp
A_tilde_exp <- A_exp - e_hat_exp

Y_tilde_obs <- Y_obs - mu_hat_obs
A_tilde_obs <- A_obs - e_hat_obs

# if any A_tilde is close to 0, the weight W will blow up
A_tilde_exp <- ifelse(abs(A_tilde_exp) < 1e-6, 1e-6, A_tilde_exp)
A_tilde_obs <- ifelse(abs(A_tilde_obs) < 1e-6, 1e-6, A_tilde_obs)

# pseudo-outcome and weights
W_exp <- Y_tilde_exp / A_tilde_exp
weights_exp <- A_tilde_exp^2

W_obs <- Y_tilde_obs / A_tilde_obs
weights_obs <- A_tilde_obs^2

# weighted regression to estimate tau(X)
tau_model_exp <- lm(W ~ ., data = data.frame(W = W_exp, X_exp), weights = weights_exp)
tau_hat_exp <- predict(tau_model_exp, newdata = X_exp)

tau_model_obs <- lm(W ~ ., data = data.frame(W = W_obs, X_obs), weights = weights_obs)
tau_hat_obs <- predict(tau_model_obs, newdata = X_obs)

# summary
summary(tau_hat_exp)
mean(tau_hat_exp)  # average treatment effect estimate for experimental data

summary(tau_hat_obs)
mean(tau_hat_obs) # average treatment effect estimate for observational data
```

```{r}
summary(tau_model_exp)
summary(tau_model_obs)
# Mean(\hat{\tau}) = -131.78 is the average treatment effect across individuals in our dataset. The difference in income between the treatment and control groups is $-131.78, so the training program decreased earnings, on average.
```

```{r}
hist(tau_hat_exp, xlab = "tau hat", main = "Estimated Treatment Effect Across Individuals for Experimental Data", breaks = 50)
hist(tau_hat_obs, xlab = "tau hat", main = "Estimated Treatment Effect Across Individuals for Observational Data", breaks = 50)
# For many individuals, it seems the treatment (training program) did not have much of an effect on their income, as the tau hat value for many individuals falls around 0. 
```

```{r}
se_exp <- sd(tau_hat_exp) / sqrt(length(tau_hat_exp))
se_exp
se_obs <- sd(tau_hat_obs) / sqrt(length(tau_hat_obs))
se_obs
```
